description: Create a new variation axis with its possible values. Use it only when get_product_options shows nothing suitable. The axis is shared across the whole catalogue, not one product — so confirm the name and values with the merchant first and reuse an existing axis when one fits.

name.description: Axis name as the merchant says it, e.g. "Size"

values.description: Possible values in display order, e.g. ["Small","Medium","Large"]

name: hub_create_product_option
title: Create product option
